_comment: Merge ONE of these blocks into your Claude Desktop config's mcpServers, then restart Claude Desktop. Config path: Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json | macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json. The bridge runs locally over stdio and is NOT network-exposed. Replace ABSOLUTE_REPO_PATH with your clone path. NOTE: the WSL block uses 'bash -c' (NOT 'bash -lc') on purpose — a login shell prints profile banners to stdout and corrupts the MCP stdio stream, which makes the server restart in a loop.
